nodes.name: Needs attention?
nodes.notes: Routine traffic must never fire a phone. Only needs_attention == true continues.

nodes.name: Get device tokens
nodes.notes: Service account bypasses security rules, so `allow read: if false` on device_tokens does not block this.

nodes.name: Build FCM payloads
nodes.notes: Emits one item per device. Edit ALERT_SOURCE_NODE to match your Firestore-write node name.

nodes.name: Send to FCM
nodes.notes: Runs once per device. neverError is deliberate: FCM v1 takes one token per request, so without it a single dead token aborts the run and everyone behind it gets nothing.
